proposals.before: Zhuangzong, the Guangsheng Shenmin Xia emperor, bore the taboo name Cunxu and was Wuhuang's eldest son.
proposals.after: Zhuangzong, the Guangsheng Shenmin Xiao emperor, bore the taboo name Cunxu and was Wuhuang's eldest son.
proposals.reason: 孝 is standardly Xiao, not Xia; the posthumous name 光聖神閔孝皇帝 should be romanized Guangsheng Shenmin Xiao.

proposals.before: Wuhuang's uprising at Yunzhong drew elite northern soldiers; when he crushed the rebels and escorted the emperor home, Cunxu's merit stood first.
proposals.after: Wuhuang's uprising at Yunzhong drew elite northern soldiers; when he crushed the rebels and escorted the emperor home, his merit stood first.
proposals.reason: 功居第一 has no subject change from 武皇起義雲中; the following sentence about spoiling troops also concerns Wuhuang, so the inserted 'Cunxu's merit' is a wrong referent.

proposals.before: He banned brigandage, aided widows and orphans, sought recluses, curbed greed and cruelty, strengthened dikes and prisons—and within a month the realm changed.
proposals.after: He banned brigandage, aided widows and orphans, sought recluses, curbed greed and cruelty, heightened dikes, and eased lawsuits—and within a month the realm changed.
proposals.reason: 寬獄訟 means easing prison litigation, not strengthening prisons; 峻堤防 is heightening dikes and defenses only.

proposals.before: In the ninth month Bin, Qi, and Shu struck Chang'an again; Cunxu sent Li Siyuan and Zhou Dewei with thirty thousand against Jinzhou in reply.
proposals.after: In the ninth month Bin, Qi, and Shu struck Chang'an again; Cunxu sent Li Sizhao and Zhou Dewei with thirty thousand against Jinzhou in reply.
proposals.reason: Chinese 李嗣昭 is Li Sizhao, a different person from 李嗣源 (Li Siyuan) named earlier in the chapter.

proposals.before: In the ninth month the Bin, Qi, and Shu three commands again mounted a great attack on Chang'an and sent Li Siyuan and Zhou Dewei with thirty thousand troops to attack Jinzhou in response.
proposals.after: In the ninth month the Bin, Qi, and Shu three commands again mounted a great attack on Chang'an and sent Li Sizhao and Zhou Dewei with thirty thousand troops to attack Jinzhou in response.
proposals.reason: Chinese 李嗣昭 is Li Sizhao, not Li Siyuan (李嗣源).

proposals.after: In the seventh month of Tianyou 7 Li Maozhen of Fengxiang and Yang Chongben of Binzhou both sent armies to join for a strike on Ling and Xia.
